languageSecurityMappings.names: Neutral snake_case retained for model methods/properties. Typed operation options remain camelCase.
languageSecurityMappings.coordinates: Current ShapePath uses explicit emu integer coordinates and viewport width/height, bounded to 2147483647 magnitude and 4096 commands; no implicit scaling, origin normalization, coordinate rounding, formula evaluation or native geometry engine. Builder construction J05 mapping remains deferred.
languageSecurityMappings.rounding: Eventual float-to-Length builder operations use J05 halfway-away-from-zero with finite/safe checks; reference constructor rounding ties-to-even is a deliberate mapped difference. Current path coordinates reject all fractions.
languageSecurityMappings.collections: Future negative at/index lookup and slicing follow source sequence semantics. Slice step is explicitly supported by J03 despite older inventory signature omitting it; zero/noninteger step fails. Includes/count/index compare owned operation identity; missing index raises typed ValueError.
languageSecurityMappings.ownership: apply_operation_to remains a public obligation on returned operation types, security-mapped to owned validated path/node views; no arbitrary XPath/XML/host objects.
languageSecurityMappings.errors: Malformed path is invalid-value; unknown commands/formula-bearing existing geometry cannot be edited; unsupported-edit is explicit. Model IndexError/ValueError/PropertyAccessError remain future obligations where model API absent.
languageSecurityMappings.closure: Explicit close command closes one active nonempty subpath; moving restarts after closure. Existing command order is retained for nonzero winding. No boolean contour subtraction or render/geometry-engine equivalence claimed.
